name: Luck icon
description: Passive icon: four-leaf clover — four circles and a darker stem. Port of the hand-drawn i_luck from Feelers' BootScene. Rim is `$cobalt`, the same as `ss.icon.spider`: this passive is the Spider Hand evolution's other half, so the pair reads as a pair on the bar. The glyph wears the rim's colour as well, so the passive is one colour on the bar.
